item.title: Virtual Reality Hypnosis: The Effectiveness of Virtual Reality Combined with Hypnotic Suggestions, a Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
item.description: Virtual reality (VR) is increasingly used to support physical and mental health interventions. Recently, VR combined with hypnotic suggestions, termed virtual reality hypnosis (VRH), has emerged as a promising approach across clinical and non-clinical settings.

item.title: Quantum neuromorphic computing: harnessing noise and adaptation for scalable quantum processors
item.description: The von Neumann bottleneck and qubit fragility limit scalable computation. This review article synthesizes recent progress in a bio-inspired quantum approach that treats noise, dissipation, and dynamics as resources, drawing from neuroscience, neuromorphic design, and quantum biology.

item.title: AwarenessBench: Assessing Cognitive Capabilities of Language Models
item.description: As language models (LMs) exhibit increasingly consciousness-like behaviors, evaluating their cognitive abilities becomes essential. We introduce AwarenessBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing the cognitive abilities of LMs in four dimensions: metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, covering 15 cognitive functions and 14,381 samples.

item.title: Security policies in quantum computing: a systematic review of literature
item.description: Abstract The rapid evolution of quantum computing introduces significant challenges for information security, particularly in governance, risk management, and the resilience of existing cryptographic mechanisms. This research reports the results of a systematic literature review (SLR) conducted following PRISMA guidelines, based on 56 peer-reviewed journal articles published between 2015 and 2025.

item.title: Improved quantum volume estimation with transducers and amortized quantum walks
item.description: The volume estimation problem is a classic task in computational geometry. The development of randomized algorithms for this problem spurred the development of many influential algorithmic techniques related to Markov Chain Monte Carlo and simulated annealing, and the problem connects to several important geometrical results, like the recently-resolved KLS conjecture.

item.title: Quantum Advantage of Permutation-Invariant Functions in Communication Complexity
item.description: We study how symmetry constrains quantum advantage in two-party communication complexity. For partial functions over any fixed alphabet of size $q$ that are invariant under simultaneous coordinate permutations, we prove that public-coin randomized and entanglement-assisted quantum communication complexities satisfy $R^{\mathrm{pub}}(f)=O_q(Q^{\ast}(f)^2\log n)$, where $n$ is the input length.

item.title: Deep Learning Methods in Neuroscience: From Modeling Molecular Mechanisms to Classifying States of Consciousness
item.description: A critical analysis of contemporary approaches to the study of conscious states. The review focuses on methods of classification, clustering, modeling of brain states under anesthesia and identification of measurable neurobiological characteristics of brain function.

item.title: The Structure of Higher-Order Quantum Resources with an Application to Coherence
item.description: We develop a general framework for higher-order quantum resources that treats the resourcefulness of quantum states, channels, and supermaps (also called processes) in a unified manner. By generalizing well-established concepts from resource theories of states and channels, we introduce and study supermap resource monotones and supermap distillation and dilution.

item.title: Present After Presence: Subtraction, Givenness, and the Structure of Being-There
item.description: Presence research has often proceeded by addition, treating immersion, embodiment, agency, ownership, co-presence, reciprocity, and temporal simultaneity as conditions that stabilise the sense of being there. Yet immersive video suggests that several of these conditions can be weakened without eliminating Presence.

item.title: The Ātma-Wave Life Cycle Framework: Bridging Vedāntic Metaphysics, Modern Physics, and State Transitions of Consciousness
item.description: Purpose: To develop a conceptual framework that integrates classical Indian metaphysics (Vedanta) with modern physics (Wave-Particle Duality) and digital/post-biological existence, utilizing high-level cognitive research skills: Analysis, Comparison, Evaluation, Interpretation, and Synthesis. This ground breaking research provides a Conceptual Framework Integrating Indian Philosophy (Dvaita & Advaita), Consciousness Studies, Physics, and Digital Reality.

item.title: A Spiking Neural Network Model of Elementary Self-Consciousness via Endogenous Default Mode Network Dynamics
item.description: Understanding the neurobiological mechanisms underlying self-referential cognition and baseline self-consciousness remains a fundamental challenge in computational neuroscience. In this work, we propose a large-scale computational model incorporating a 10,000-neuron spiking neural network (SNN) based on Izhikevich dynamics.

item.title: Electroencephalography as a biomarker of brain function in domestic ruminants: a systematic review and critical appraisal
item.description: BACKGROUND: Electroencephalography (EEG) has been extensively used to investigate cortical activity in ruminants under physiological, pathological, and experimental conditions. Its applications range from the assessment of consciousness and nociception to experimental models of hypoxia-ischemia, neurodevelopment, pain, anesthesia, and neurological disorders.

item.title: Does Global Neuronal Workspace Theory Explain Phenomenal Consciousness? The Motivated Emotional Mind Challenge
item.description: Global Neuronal Workspace Theory (GNWT) is one of the most extensively developed empirical research programmes on access consciousness. By contrast, the Motivated Emotional Mind (MEM) model proposes an embodied, semi-hierarchical associative memory in which representational selection, action, recurrent reconstruction of modality-specific fields, interoception, and valence form a single functional cycle.

item.title: Immediate large-scale cortical network changes following acupuncture in patients with disorders of consciousness: a resting-state fNIRS study
item.description: Introduction Disorders of consciousness (DOC) involve severe disruption of large-scale brain networks. This study investigated immediate cortical network changes following acupuncture in patients with DOC using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS).
